goal: HttpClient review: client lifetime, timeouts, retry policy and handling of responses.
use: HttpClient review: client lifetime, timeouts, retry policy and handling of responses. Use when code calls external services with HttpClient.

steps.note: List the clients and how each is created.
Check lifetime. Flag a new client per request, which exhausts sockets.
Check timeouts. Every client needs a timeout.
Check retries. Retries need a limit and back-off, and only for safe calls.
Report. Each client with file and line, the problem and the fix.
